title: Business Analyst
text: Business Analyst at Ajilon (Brisbane, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). One of our premium clients based in Brisbane is looking for a highly experienced and committed Business Analyst. This key position will be responsible to join the team to assist with delivering projects within the Australian and New Zealand region to meet customer demands and requirements. In this role, you will be given the opportunity to make a tangible contribution to the continued innovation and success of the company. Skills & Experience The Business Analyst must be able to: Assist the sales team in preparing for sales meetings and demonstrations by providing technical and safety rules support To achieve smooth and professional delivery of client projects and to ensure, beyond all other competing demands, that clients' expectations are constantly exceeded Provide database support both on site and remotely where necessary Provide the clients (internal and external) with new releases of software and upgrade instructions To attend client user group meetings To verify new releases of software meets the customer requirements Manage functionality requests for clients To provide on call support for clients when necessary If necessary, attend software installation and configuration at client sites Organise and carry out user training on-site or at client offices Desirable Experience of using an industry standard project methodology Microsoft Project, Excel TSQL / MSSQL / Oracle database experience Essentials Professional Outgoing Manner Clean Driving License Valid Passport Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Self-motivated, results focused and able to work on own initiative Strong analytical, planning and organisational abilities Ability to travel as required Ajilon is a national professional services company with global capability. Our committed and talented professionals have delivered world class IT and business consulting services across a wide range of industries. As a member of global professional services group Adecco, we offer world-class employment opportunities. Talented, committed, can-do individuals have always been the cornerstone of this dynamic business. It is expected that the successful candidate will bring energetic dynamics and a strong Business Analyst skill set to this organisation. For more information on the role, please contact Payal Seth on 07 3000 1563 "Ajilon is an Equal Opportunity employer, committed to all forms of workforce inclusion. We actively invite and encourage applications by candidates from diverse backgrounds"
